nodes.label: Large Bundle Size Pattern
nodes.rationale: Bundlers already tree-shake ESM; real gains come from route-level code splitting and lazy loading.

nodes.label: Missing Caching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Cache only expensive, read-heavy data; key must include every input (viewer, tenant) and one explicit invalidation strategy.

nodes.label: Queries That Ignore Their Index Pattern
nodes.norm_label: queries that ignore their index pattern

nodes.label: Measure-Identify-Fix-Verify-Guard Workflow
nodes.rationale: Fix only the single measured bottleneck; keep or revert based on re-measurement to avoid guess-driven optimization.

nodes.label: Vertical Slicing
nodes.rationale: Slice work end-to-end per feature so each task delivers a testable, working increment rather than horizontal layers.

nodes.label: Destructive Operations on Derived Paths
nodes.rationale: Marker/self-attestation checks are weaker than they read due to check/use races.

nodes.label: Threat Model First
nodes.rationale: Map trust boundaries and attackers before applying controls so effort targets real exposure.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Boundary System (Always / Ask First / Never)
nodes.norm_label: three-tier boundary system (always / ask first / never)

nodes.label: Staged Rollout
nodes.rationale: Expose changes gradually with decision thresholds so failures hit few users and can be rolled back.

nodes.label: Gated Workflow (Scope/Specify/Plan/Tasks/Implement)
nodes.rationale: Gate each phase on human review so ambiguity is resolved before code is written.

nodes.label: Prove-It Pattern (Bug Fixes)
nodes.rationale: Reproduce a bug with a failing test before fixing, proving the fix and preventing regression.

nodes.label: Core Operating Behaviors
nodes.rationale: Surface assumptions, push back, enforce simplicity, keep scope discipline, verify rather than assume.

nodes.label: Five-Axis Review
nodes.rationale: Review correctness, readability, architecture, security and performance separately so no dimension is skipped.

nodes.label: Fresh-Context Adversarial Reviewer
nodes.rationale: A reviewer without the author's context cannot share its blind spots.

nodes.label: Stop-the-Line Rule
nodes.rationale: Stop adding features when something breaks; errors compound.

nodes.label: Triage Checklist (Reproduce, Localize, Reduce, Fix, Guard, Verify)
nodes.norm_label: triage checklist (reproduce, localize, reduce, fix, guard, verify)

nodes.label: Feeding CI Failures Back to Agents
nodes.norm_label: feeding ci failures back to agents

nodes.label: Assumption Audit
nodes.rationale: Sort assumptions into must/should/might be true to find dealbreakers early.

nodes.label: Core Evaluation Dimensions (User Value, Feasibility, Differentiation)
nodes.norm_label: core evaluation dimensions (user value, feasibility, differentiation)

nodes.label: Three-Phase Ideation (Understand & Expand, Evaluate & Converge, Sharpen & Ship)
nodes.norm_label: three-phase ideation (understand & expand, evaluate & converge, sharpen & ship)

nodes.label: Hyrum's Law
nodes.rationale: All observable behaviors of an API will be depended on by someone, so every exposed behavior is a de-facto contract.

nodes.label: Prefer Addition Over Modification
nodes.rationale: Additive changes avoid breaking existing consumers.

nodes.label: Cite Your Sources
nodes.rationale: Ground every implementation decision in official, version-matched docs to avoid outdated patterns.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Record (ADR)

nodes.label: Floor Guard Contract

nodes.label: CONSTRAINTS.md

nodes.label: Ratchets
nodes.rationale: When no target number is known, lock current measured value and only allow improvement.

nodes.label: Chesterton's Fence
nodes.rationale: Understand why code exists before removing or changing it.
